# The Crypto Playback

> Free daily Bitcoin and crypto market research. A live dashboard of 16 market indicators (sentiment, risk, ETF flows,
> stablecoin liquidity, leverage, on-chain activity and more), refreshed every 15 minutes, plus a concise newsletter
> published Monday through Saturday. Not financial advice.

## Main pages
- [Home and live dashboard](https://cryptoplayback.com/)
- [The Crypto Playback Lab: market-structure indicators (institutional pressure, crowded unwind risk, protocol revenue/TVL quality, stablecoin flows)](https://cryptoplayback.com/playback-lab.html)
- [Newsletter archive](https://cryptoplayback.com/archive.html)
- [Resources and glossary](https://cryptoplayback.com/resources.html)
- [About](https://cryptoplayback.com/about.html)
- [RSS feed](https://cryptoplayback.com/feed.xml)
